1844 is a leap year (divisible by 4, not a century exception).  
From 10-21-1844:  
Days left in October: 31 - 21 = 10 days.  
November: 30 days → total 40 days.  
December: 31 days → total 71 days.  
261 - 71 = 190 days remain into 1845.  

1845 is not a leap year (not divisible by 4).  
January: 31 → 71+31=102, 190-31=159 left.  
February: 28 → 159-28=131 left.  
March: 31 → 131-31=100 left.  
April: 30 → 100-30=70 left.  
May: 31 → 70-31=39 left.  
June: 30 → 39-30=9 left.  
July: 9 days → July 9, 1845.  

FINAL_ANSWER: 1845-07-09
